notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR14: 'The MCS updates the content of the data item referenced by data-name-11 only as part of the execution of an ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT statement.' Only AcceptMessageCount calls SetMessageCount (from QueueNode.CompleteMessages, counting sub-queues under a prefix); SetReceived never touches positions 82-87. Probe gr1 at --std 85: a preset 999999 survives two RECEIVEs, ACCEPT gives 1 for Q1 and 1 for Q1/S1, a later RECEIVE leaves 1, ACCEPT then gives 0, and an unknown queue leaves 777 with status 20. The witness checks the count.
